author: Sam Illingworth
reported_outcomes: Reports finding the forced non-answer more generous; no epistemic calibration measure.
proposed_outcomes: Stay with an unresolved question and turn uncertainty into creative material.
limits: The model is instructed to say it does not know, so the response says nothing about actual uncertainty.
Its claim about what science needs to know can itself be wrong.
review_note: Merge as a creative uncertainty variant, explicitly not an honesty or calibration technique.
coverage: Close-read all 138 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
